# a re-packed copy: same program, but one more block at the end of the layer, so the layer, the config and the image id differ
set -e
W=$(mktemp -d)
python3 - /tmp/bench67607380/myimage.tar "$W/copy.tar" docker.io/library/bench67607380-hello:latest <<'EOF'
import hashlib, io, json, sys, tarfile
src, dst, name = sys.argv[1:4]
t = tarfile.open(src)
m = json.load(t.extractfile("manifest.json"))[0]
layer = t.extractfile(m["Layers"][0]).read() + b"\0" * 512
cfg = json.loads(t.extractfile(m["Config"]).read())
cfg["rootfs"]["diff_ids"] = ["sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(layer).hexdigest()]
cfgb = json.dumps(cfg, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
cid = hashlib.sha256(cfgb).hexdigest()
man = json.dumps([{"Config": cid + ".json", "RepoTags": [name], "Layers": ["layer/layer.tar"]}]).encode()
with tarfile.open(dst, "w") as o:
    for n, b in (("layer/layer.tar", layer), (cid + ".json", cfgb), ("manifest.json", man)):
        ti = tarfile.TarInfo(n); ti.size = len(b); o.addfile(ti, io.BytesIO(b))
EOF
sudo ctr -a /run/bench67607380/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images import "$W/copy.tar"
rm -rf "$W"
